identity.name: Rappler
identity.description: A Filipino digital news organisation known for investigative reporting, data journalism, fact-checking and coverage of politics, justice and society.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Rappler Holdings owns 98.77% of the operating company. Major holders include Dolphin Fire (31.21%), Maria Ressa (23.77%), Hatchd (17.86%) and Benjamin So (17.86%). Omidyar Network and North Base Media provided funding through Philippine Depositary Receipts.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Independent digital newsroom with a strong record of holding Philippine governments to account, including during the Duterte administration; legal and funding pressures have been documented.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: No parsed MBFC rating; self-assessed centre-left based on its rights, accountability and civil-liberties coverage.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage is secondary and accountability-oriented rather than consistently pro-market.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: Philippine national lens with a pro-democracy, human-rights and accountability orientation.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Award-winning investigative newsroom with named reporters, fact-checking and corrections; no external rating parsed.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: No clean MBFC rating parsed for Rappler.

intelligence.knownPerspective: Filipino accountability journalism with a strong investigative and fact-checking orientation, often focused on power, disinformation and impunity.

selectionRationale: Adds independent Philippine investigative capacity and a Southeast Asian civil-society perspective.

research.researchNotes: Official About page accessible. Ownership percentages and PDR financing from Wikipedia and Rappler disclosures; PDR status is time-sensitive and requires legal review. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
